title: Investigation response
description: PERD §39.2: the response of GET /v1/investigations/{investigation_id}, the current state for the overlay: {state, last_answer, case_ref_masked?}, with schema_version (PERD §39.1: bodies carry it). 'state' is the investigation state of PERD §28.2 (the list is services/core/orchestrator/transitions.yaml, compared by tools/contracts/test_public_api.py); the overlay maps it to a plain stage string (PERD §13) and never shows the code. 'last_answer' is absent until a final answer exists. 'case_ref_masked' is shown only after case_opened is ACHIEVED and carries no run of five or more digits (A154). New in this contract set; no earlier contract changes (AGENT-15).

InvestigationState.description: PERD §28.2 states (21). FROZEN is a target-level flag, not an investigation state.
